Germany does not collect race or ethnicity. The nearest variables are migration background (MImigrant) and the parents' grouped country of origin (MIhlandB_k: Germany, Turkey, former Soviet states, Poland, Southern Europe/Mediterranean, rest of Europe/USA/Canada/Israel/Australia, Arab countries/North Africa, rest of world). Those are geographic origin categories, not ethnic groups, and several ('rest of world', 'Arab countries/North Africa') have no defensible target in the White/Black/Mixed/Asian/Hispanic schema. Mapped to minority instead.
Germany has no indigenous population category and none is collected.

MImigrant is KiGGS's two-sided migration background indicator (a child counts as a migrant when both parents have a migration background; one-sided or no background counts as non-migrant; see KiGGS_Migrantenvariablen_Erklaerung.pdf). Proximate because migration background is Germany's standard minority proxy but is not the same construct as ethnic minority status - it excludes one-sided-background children who may still be visible minorities. 1,558 migrants, 13,293 non-migrants, 172 missing.

expression:
as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids1)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids2)) +
  (6 - as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids3))) +
  (6 - as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids4))) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids5)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids6)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids7)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids8)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids9)) +
  as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(LQkids10))
notes: KiGGS administered the KIDSCREEN-27 to 11-17 year olds and released the items rather than an index. LQkids1-10 are exactly the ten KIDSCREEN-10 items in the published order (felt fit and well, full of energy, felt sad, felt lonely, enough time for yourself, able to do what you want in your free time, treated fairly by parents, had fun with friends, got on well at school, able to pay attention), each on the standard 1-5 scale. The two negatively worded items (LQkids3 sad, LQkids4 lonely) are reversed as 6 - x, giving the raw sum 10-50 with higher meaning better quality of life. All ten items must be present, giving 5,897 rows (observed range 17-50, median 42). LQEkidsB is the RKI's own KIDSCREEN-10 index but is a parent proxy for ages 7-10 only, so it is mapped to wb_qol_kidscreen10_parent instead; the two are disjoint.

LQEkidsB is the RKI's own KIDSCREEN-10 index from the parent questionnaire, already the raw sum of the ten items on 1-5 item scoring, so it is used as released with no rescaling (observed range 23-50, mean 42.3, sd 4.0, 3,288 rows). Computed only for ages 7-10 - the value label on the missing code is 'Nicht berechnet (<7 o. 11+ Jahre)' - so it does not overlap wb_qol_kidscreen10_self, which covers 11-17 (0 rows have both). The parent items themselves are not released, only this index. LQEkidsB_r (Rasch person parameter, -1.01 to 5.44) and LQEkidsB_t (international Rasch-based T-values, 24.8 to 87.9) are the same index on other metrics and are not used, since the dataschema asks for the 10-50 raw sum.
Instrument not administered in KiGGS Wave 2.
